decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T2	Common Lime (Tilia x europaea)	Raise crown over footpath to give 2.5m clearance, but retain screening. Raise crown over road to give 3.5m clearance, but retain screening. Reduce away from buildings to give 1.5m clearance. Reduce low limb at 3.5m to west, where overhanging rear of 36 Lonsdale Road, back to the most recent previous reduction point, removing approx 3m of new growth - Retain some furnishing growth at reduction point. 
Final height unchanged at 13m, final spread 7m.
